title: 관성 출근
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Funk with a heavy emphasis on slap bass and syncopated guitar scratching. The arrangement features a bright, clean electric guitar playing muted 16th-note rhythmic patterns and a prominent electric bass that utilizes thumb slaps and finger pops. A digital piano provides staccato chord stabs on the off-beats. The drums consist of a crisp snare and a tight, dry kick drum. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, rhythmic tenor with occasional breathy ad-libs and melodic runs. The track is in the key of B Minor at 115 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass riff, muted electric guitar scratching, tight drum beat]
(Hoo!)

[Verse 1]
[staccato digital piano chords]
알람이 울려 3초만 더
이불 속에서 생각해
왜 가지 왜 이러나 제대답 없이 신발 신어
[bass slides down]

[Chorus]
[full funk arrangement, slap bass becomes more active]
관성으로 간다 이유 없이도 간다
형광등 아래 앉아 키보드 위에 손을 올려
머리는 멍해 손만 움직여
오늘도 관성으로 간다
[clean electric guitar solo lick]

[Outro]
지하철 유리에 얼굴이 비쳐
옆 사람의 얼굴이 비쳐
